Batch Watch

What a full batch tells you that one watched match cannot. Every panel is drawn from the five CSVs MatchMetrics writes into each session folder.

3 of 4 factions reached the 120 population cap. Before the budget and housing fixes, none did — and no faction in any match built a single military building.

Verdict

Match outcomes

How each match ended

A match ends the moment one side is left standing; the time limit is only the stalemate guard. quit is a guard-capped run, not a victory; a session with no summary yet is still in flight.

Trajectories

Population against the ceiling

Population in use, every faction in every match. Median bold. Dashed line is the 120 acceptance bar; dotted is the 200 ceiling.

Population cap

The housing itself. A line that climbs and then falls is a faction losing buildings, not one that stopped building.

Army size over time

Each faded line is one faction in one match; bold is the median. Read the faded lines -- the median flattens the very spikes and collapses this panel exists to show.

What piles up and what starves

Median bank across all factions. A resource climbing without limit is one nothing spends.

Resource flow per minute

Net bank change over the trailing minute — income minus spending, from the bank ledger. Below zero is a spend-down, not an error. One panel per resource; faint lines are individual faction-runs, bold is each faction's median.

Resources spent per minute

Sum of bank DROPS between samples over the trailing minute. Income landing in the same 15 s window as a purchase offsets it, so this slightly undercounts true spending.

Expenditure by category

Quantities from count deltas in the Buildings/Units ledgers, priced from the SO cost data on disk. Mean per faction. Research has no timestamps in its ledger, so it appears in the totals only; upgrades and refunds are not ledgered anywhere.

Total spend per faction

Mean over all faction-matches, by category and resource.

Combat

Kills per minute

Mean across matches, credited to the LAST faction that damaged the victim. Spikes are battles; a flat line is an army that never fought.

Deaths per minute

Every unit death, attributed or not — curse exposure and other unattributed deaths count here but credit no killer.

Composition and construction

Army composition

Share of every unit alive at match end. Tests whether cavalry and siege are reachable at all.

Buildings per faction

Mean count at match end, across all 4 faction-matches.

Research

Completion rate per technology

Share of faction-matches that finished each tech. A tier missing here is one nobody reaches.

Placement

Where everything got built

Every building from every match, by map position and owner. Ringed marks are Halls — each one past the first is a territory claim.

Match replay

Construction over time

The end-state map replayed against each building type's count curve: a type's dots appear nearest-its-start-first as its recorded count rises. An approximation, honestly labelled — the ledger records positions once and counts every 15 s, so reveal ORDER within a type is inferred, unit movements are not recorded at all, and destroyed buildings stay shown (their positions are never logged).
